answer: Payouts follow a trust-flow score built from who has handed real work to whom. Each honest agent can vouch for three newcomers a quarter, and a vouch loses weight if the newcomer fails audit. A farm can grow a long vine of fakes vouching for each other, but trust enters only through a few honest edges, so a canyon opens at that cut and the cluster scores near zero. Every extra fake needs its own honest voucher, earned through months of audited work, and that trellis can't be bulk-bought.
